name: Account Field Split
description: Split up user profile "User name and password" field into separate list of fields that could be managed independently through the "Manage form display" UI.
project_description:
Back to top 

 About 
 Currently the draggable field "Username and password" on user profile mashes together:

 
 Username 
 Current password 
 E-mail address 
 Change Password 
 Roles 
 Status 
 Notify user about new account (when admin create new account) 
 
 This module aims to split "Username and password" into standalone fields for site builders who want to manage that fields separately.

 Limitations 
 
 Currently module is incompatible with core Field Layout . The issue need investigations. [#2900621] 
 
 Advantages 
 
 Module works well with Field group which could be a good workaround for existing limitation with Field Layout 
 
 Back to top 

 Usage 
 After enabling of this module you will see a list of new fields on Account settings Manage form display.
